newsitem.title: UK: Slow start to week on mixed UK meals and feeds.
newsitem.headline: Slow start to week on mixed UK meals and feeds.

text.p: Sellers were mixed on the UK meals and feeds market on Monday, but business was slow to start.
High protein soymeal started the week two stg down to one stg up but buyers stayed away.
On the rape meal market January A.D.M. material fetched 124 stg a tonne.
Traders said they held out little hope of much of an improvement on Tuesday following the higher Chicago opening.
"One look at Chicago is enough to tell us we can forget Tuesday as well," said one.
